# RotateSprite <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Sprites](Blitz3D-Sprites)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RotateSprite:Void sprite:Int32, angle:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sprite` | In | Int32 | required | The sprite. |
| `angle` | In | Float32 | required | Roll angle in degrees. |

## Description

Rolls a sprite around the line from the camera to it. The angle is absolute, in degrees, and not added to the old one. A rolling sprite is the usual way to make spinning smoke or sparks.
